requester_vs_agent_ownership: These are explicit agent-owned testcase requirements from the independently frozen baseline; requester text is unchanged. Source-profile associations were identified only post-core and do not promote unexposed profiles to pack duties.
grading_rule: All required parts and relations must coexist in the same native saved image. Partial is FAIL. Hidden or unassessable required evidence is UNOBSERVABLE and cannot PASS. Keyword status uses PASS/FAIL/UNOBSERVABLE; overall is PASS only if every keyword PASS.

required_parts: compact dark hair mass ends near chin or jaw
lower tips make a short readable face-framing perimeter
required_relations: the tips and hair mass belong to the same hair owner; the tucked right side may leave the ear exposed but does not become long rear hair
confusion_boundaries: long side locks over longer rear hair
a close crop hiding the lower hair edge
keywords.visibility: Native pixels must reveal the actual lower bob outline and endpoints.

keywords.owner: main fictional adult subject front hair
required_parts: front hair descends across the forehead
ends align in one blunt transverse edge around brow level
required_relations: the fringe stays distinct from the beret band and is on the same head as the bob
confusion_boundaries: wispy separated strands with no shared blunt edge
keywords.visibility: Native pixels show the full front section below the beret.

keywords.owner: main fictional adult subject eyewear over eyes
required_parts: one thin approximately circular gold rim encloses each eye-region lens
a central bridge joins those same rims over the nose
both eyes remain visible inside the lenses
required_relations: bridge and two rims form one coherent eyeglass frame on the face
confusion_boundaries: eyeglasses on the hat or hair
keywords.visibility: Native view must resolve the two rims and nose bridge as separate coherent metal boundaries.

required_relations: one complete beret sits above the fringe on the same head, tilted toward the subject left
confusion_boundaries: partial crown hidden outside the frame
keywords.visibility: Native frame includes the entire crown and its boundary against the hair.

keywords.owner: main fictional adult subject right hair and ear

right ear upper cartilage and lobe are exposed
required_relations: the subject right ear is the ear carrying both cuff and dangling earring
confusion_boundaries: headwear edge mistaken for ear outline
keywords.visibility: Camera and hair must expose the upper helix and earlobe in native pixels; side is actor-relative.

keywords.owner: main fictional adult subject right upper-ear cartilage
required_parts: cuff visibly wraps or encircles the upper cartilage
required_relations: cuff is attached to the upper part of the exposed right ear and is separate from the lobe earring

keywords.owner: main fictional adult subject right earlobe

confusion_boundaries: drop attached to spectacles or upper cuff instead of earlobe
keywords.visibility: Native pixels resolve lobe attachment, hanging drop and separation from upper cuff.
